context_for_next_testing_agent: Variant generation feature fully tested. Key endpoints: POST /api/items/{id}/preview-variants (returns all combinations with exists flag), POST /api/items/{id}/generate-variants (creates/reactivates/retires variants). backend.description: POST /api/items/{id}/preview-variants returns all 4 combinations (2x2) with correct SKUs

Preview shows existing variants with exists=true after generation
Removing attribute value and regenerating retires the corresponding variant (deactivated_skus)
Re-adding attribute value and regenerating reactivates the retired variant (reactivated_skus)
POST /api/items saves variant_attributes with {value, short_code} object schema
GET /api/items?lite=1 includes variant_attributes for items that have them
POST /api/production creates SO with variant_selection on lines

Generate on item without variant_attributes returns 400
